name: Natalie
source:
A homunculus (artificial human) created to take care of humans. As such, they have only very ordinary abilities and no special skills. Originally, homunculus do not have emotions, but Natalie was a mistake in the creation process and ended up with emotions.

[Translated from the [url=http://liquid.nexton-net.jp/darklord/character.html#chr06]official website[/url]]
